q: Shrimps keep their heart up in their head! 🦐
You fold a sheet of paper in half, then in half again, then in half once more. How many layers thick is it?
Each fold doubles the layers: 2, then 4, then 8! 📄
What can your right hand hold that your left hand never can?
Try it: no hand can ever grab its own elbow! 💪
Which direction does the Nile River flow?
The Nile flows north from the middle of Africa all the way to the sea! 🌊
A man walks 1 km south, 1 km east, then 1 km north, and ends up where he started. Where is he?
From the North Pole every way is south, and north leads right back! 🧭
What color is the milk of a brown cow?
Brown cows give white milk; chocolate milk is made by people! 🐄
There are 2 ducks in front of a duck, 2 ducks behind a duck and 1 duck in the middle. How many ducks are there?
Just 3 ducks in a row fit every part of that sentence! 🦆
You tear pages 1 and 2 and pages 99 and 100 out of a 100-page book. How many sheets of paper did you remove?
Pages 1 and 2 are the two sides of one sheet, and so are 99 and 100! 📖
Which of these is NOT a fish?
Seahorses, sharks and eels are all fish, but a dolphin is a mammal! 🐬
How many stars are there in our solar system?
Just one: the Sun is a star! ☀️
Ali buys a bike for 60 coins, sells it for 70, buys it back for 80, then sells it for 90. How much did he gain?
He made 10 coins on each sale: 10 + 10 = 20! 🚲
9.9 is the same as 9.90, which beats 9.11! 🔢
Where does moonlight really come from?
The Moon doesn't glow by itself; it reflects sunlight like a mirror! 🌕
A dark drawer holds 10 red socks and 10 blue socks. How many must you take out to be sure of a matching pair?
With only 2 colors, the 3rd sock must match one of the first 2! 🧦
A rooster lays an egg on the very top of a pointed roof. Which side does the egg roll down?
Only hens lay eggs, so there is nothing to roll! 🐓
What is inside an empty glass bottle with its cap on?
An empty bottle is full of air: you just can't see it! 💨
A dog and a parrot are alone in an empty room, and then you walk in. How many legs are in the room now?
Dog 4, parrot 2, and don't forget your own 2 legs! 🐕
Which planet has the hottest surface in our solar system?
Mercury is closer to the Sun, but Venus's thick clouds trap the heat! 🔥
It takes 10 minutes to boil 1 egg. How long does it take to boil 3 eggs together in the same pot?
They all cook at the same time in the same water! 🥚
You jump straight up inside a train moving smoothly at a steady speed. Where do you land?
You were already moving with the train, so you keep up with it! 🚄
What is the largest desert in the world?
A desert gets very little rain or snow, and Antarctica is the biggest one! 🐧
You see lightning and hear the thunder 3 seconds later. About how far away was it?
Sound travels about 1 km every 3 seconds, while light arrives at once! ⚡
Which is heavier: 1 kg of feathers or 1 kg of stones?
A kilo is a kilo, fluffy or hard! 🪶
A million seconds is only about 11 and a half days! ⏱️
What two things can you never eat for breakfast?
Whatever you eat in the morning is breakfast, not lunch or dinner! 🍳
A brick weighs 1 kg plus half a brick. How much does the whole brick weigh?
If half a brick is 1 kg, the whole brick must be 2 kg! 🧱
An electric train is going north while the wind blows to the west. Which way does its smoke go?
Electric trains don't make any smoke at all! 🚆
How many fingers are there on 10 hands?
Each hand has 5 fingers, so 10 hands have 50, not 100! ✋
A horse is tied to a 3 m rope, but it eats grass 10 m away. How?
The rope is on the horse, but its other end is tied to nothing! 🐴
5 friends meet, and each one shakes hands once with every other friend. How many handshakes are there?
5 times 4 counts every handshake twice, so it's 20 ÷ 2 = 10! 🤝
In a house with only one floor, everything is blue. What color are the stairs?
A house with one floor doesn't need any stairs! 🏠
If you leave the fridge door open in a small closed room, what happens to the room?
A fridge pushes heat out the back, and its motor adds even more! 🌡️
Which of these can an owl NOT move?
Owl eyes are fixed in place, so owls turn their whole head instead! 🦉
Queen Cleopatra of Egypt lived closer in time to which of these?
The Great Pyramid was already about 2,500 years old when Cleopatra was born! 🏛️
Two days ago Ali was 9, and next year he will turn 12. What is today's date?
Born on December 31: 9 two days ago, 10 yesterday, 11 this year, 12 next! 🎂
How much soil is in a hole that is 1 meter deep, 1 meter long and 1 meter wide?
It's a hole, so all the soil has already been dug out! 🕳️
Where can you find cities, rivers and mountains, but not a single person or tree?
A map shows all the places, but no people or trees! 🗺️
Which taste can cats NOT taste?
Cats are missing the sweet taste sensor, so candy means nothing to them! 🐱
What happens to a party balloon full of air if you put it in the freezer?
Cold air takes up less space, so the balloon gets smaller! 🎈
What do you get if you multiply all the numbers from 0 to 9 together?
Anything times 0 is 0, no matter how big the other numbers are! 😮
How many bones does a shark have?
A shark's skeleton is cartilage, the bendy stuff in your nose and ears! 🦈
A mom and dad have 4 daughters, and each daughter has 1 brother. How many people are in the family?
All 4 girls share the same brother: 2 parents + 4 girls + 1 boy = 7! 🏠
What is 30 divided by one half, plus 10?
Dividing by a half doubles it: 30 becomes 60, plus 10 makes 70! ➗
Two fathers and two sons each ate 1 whole cake, yet only 3 cakes were eaten. How can that be?
The dad is both a father and a son, so only 3 people ate! 🍰
You have 1 match and walk into a cold, dark room with a candle, an oil lamp and a stove. What do you light first?
Nothing else can be lit until the match is burning! 🔥
Which is more pizza: one round 30 cm pizza, or two round 20 cm pizzas?
Pizza grows with width times width: 30 × 30 = 900 beats 400 + 400! 🍕
In which place do polar bears and penguins live together in the wild?
Polar bears live up north and penguins down south, so they never meet! 🐧
A hen weighs 2 kg standing on two legs. How much does it weigh standing on one leg?
Lifting a leg doesn't make a hen any lighter! 🐔
How many hearts does an octopus have?
One heart pumps blood around the body, and two pump it through the gills! 🐙
In the same room, one ice cube sits on a metal plate and one on a wooden board. Which melts first?
Metal feels cold, but it passes the room's heat into the ice much faster! 🍽️
How can you throw a ball so it comes right back to you, without a wall, a string or anyone catching it?
Up it goes, and down it comes, right back into your hands! 🙌
A square room has a cat in each corner, and each cat sees 3 cats. How many cats are in the room?
Each of the 4 cats simply sees the other 3! 🐈
The sunlight reaching Earth right now left the Sun how long ago?
Light is fast, but the Sun is so far away it takes about 8 minutes! ☀️
Below zero, the closer you are to 0, the bigger you are! 🌡️
What happens to a red stone when you throw it into the blue sea?
The sea isn't paint: the stone just gets wet! 🌊
How many wings does a honeybee have?
Bees have 2 pairs of wings that hook together when they fly! 🐝
A 1 kg block of ice melts inside a closed bag. How much does the water weigh?
Melting turns ice into water, but it doesn't change the weight! ⚖️
A pear tree has 10 branches, and each branch has 5 apples. How many apples are on the tree?
It's a pear tree, so it grows pears, not apples! 🍐
A taxi driver goes the wrong way down a one-way street, right past a police officer. Why is that okay?
Nobody said he was driving his taxi: he was on foot! 🚶
On a cake, 10 candles are lit; the wind blows out 3 and the rest burn all the way down. How many candles are left?
The 7 that kept burning melted away; only the 3 blown out are left! 🕯️
There are 3 apples on a table and you take away 2. How many apples do you have?
You took 2, so you have 2, and the table keeps 1! 🍎
At the start of a football (soccer) match, how many players are on the field?
Each team has 11 players, and there are 2 teams! ⚽
How can two people stand on the same open newspaper and still not be able to touch each other?
Slide it under a closed door, and each stands on one side! 🚪
How many minutes are there in 1.5 hours?
Half an hour is 30 minutes, so 1.5 hours is 60 + 30 = 90! ⏰
Seen from space, what color is the Sun?
Our air makes the Sun look yellow; from space it shines white! 🚀
How can you give 5 friends 1 apple each from a basket of 5 apples, and still leave 1 apple in the basket?
The last friend gets the basket with the apple still inside! 🧺
Which of these animals is a bird?
Penguins can't fly, but they are birds with feathers and beaks! 🐧
When Omar was 6, his sister was half his age. If Omar is 40 now, how old is his sister?
She was 3 when he was 6, so she is always 3 years younger! 👧
Add these in your head: 1,000 + 40 + 1,000 + 30 + 1,000 + 20 + 1,000 + 10. What do you get?
The small ones add up to 100, not 1,000: 4,000 + 100 = 4,100! 🧮
If you call a dog's tail a leg, how many legs does the dog have?
Calling a tail a leg doesn't make it one! 🐕
A glass is filled to the very top with water and floating ice. When the ice melts, what happens?
Floating ice already pushes away exactly as much water as it melts into! 🧊
Crickets hear with tiny ears just below their knees! 🦗
What is the last day of a leap year?
A leap year gets an extra day in February, but it still ends on December 31! 📅
A snail in a 10 m well climbs 3 m every day and slides down 2 m every night. On which day does it get out?
After 7 days and nights it's at 7 m, and on day 8 it climbs the last 3 m! 🐌
A ship's ladder has 3 steps under water, each 50 cm apart. If the tide rises 1 m, how many steps are under water?
The ship floats up with the water, and the ladder goes up too! ⛵
Starting at noon, how many times will a clock's hour hand and minute hand meet in the next 12 hours?
The hands meet about every 65 minutes, so only 11 times in 12 hours! 🕛
Which is more cake: a cake cut into 8 pieces, or the same cake cut into 12 pieces?
Cutting it differently doesn't add any cake! 🎂
Half of a number is 10. What is double that number?
The number is 20, so double it and you get 40! ✌️
Peanut flowers poke down into the soil, and the peanuts grow there! 🥜
In which month is Earth closest to the Sun?
Seasons come from Earth's tilt, not from its distance to the Sun! 🌍
Water is boiling in a pot at sea level. If you turn the heat up to the max, how hot does the water get?
Extra heat makes it boil faster, not hotter! ♨️
A toy is 50% off, then another 50% off the new price. How much cheaper is it in total?
Half off, then half of that half off: a quarter of the price is left! 🏷️
On a hot day, where do the water drops on the outside of a cold glass come from?
Invisible water vapor in the air turns into drops on the cold glass! 💧
From the same cake, which piece is bigger: one third or one quarter?
Sharing with 3 people gives bigger pieces than sharing with 4! 🍰
On the Moon, an astronaut drops a hammer and a feather at the same time. Which lands first?
With no air to slow the feather, both fall at the same speed! 🌕
Where does most of the material that makes up wood come from?
Trees build their wood from carbon dioxide taken out of the air! 🌳
If the day after tomorrow is Sunday, what day was yesterday?
Tomorrow is Saturday and today is Friday, so yesterday was Thursday! 🗓️
What does a camel store in its hump?
The hump is a fat store that gives the camel energy on long trips! 🐪
You push 3 piles of sand together with 5 more piles of sand. How many piles do you have now?
Push them all together and you get 1 giant pile! 🏖️
Water lilies double every day and cover a whole pond on day 30. On which day was half the pond covered?
They double every day, so half covered is just 1 day before full! 🌸
At 8 in the evening, you set an old alarm clock with hands to ring at 9 in the morning. When will it ring?
A clock with hands can't tell morning from evening, so it rings at 9 tonight! ⏰
When you see a rainbow, where is the Sun?
Rainbows appear when the Sun shines from behind you into the rain! 🌈
A farmer has 15 sheep, and all except 8 run away. How many sheep are left?
All except 8 ran away, so exactly 8 stayed! 🐑
Before Mount Everest was measured, what was the highest mountain on Earth?
It was always the highest; nobody had measured it yet! 🏔️
In which month do people sleep the fewest nights?
February has the fewest days, so it has the fewest nights too! 🌙
A square card has 4 corners. If you cut off 1 corner in a straight line, how many corners does it have?
Cutting off 1 corner makes 2 new ones: 4 - 1 + 2 = 5! ✂️
What is the capital city of Australia?
Sydney is bigger and more famous, but the capital is Canberra! 🦘
What color is a baby flamingo?
Flamingos turn pink later, from the food they eat! 🦩
Which hand should you use to stir your tea?
Hands hold the spoon; they don't go in the hot tea! 🥄
Measured from its base to its peak, which mountain is the tallest on Earth?
Most of Mauna Kea hides under the sea; Everest is highest above sea level! 🌋
Which weighs more: a football pumped full of air, or the same football with no air in it?
Air weighs something too, so the pumped ball is a few grams heavier! ⚽
On each birthday, Sara gets 1 candle for each year of her age. By her 5th birthday, how many candles has she blown out?
What belongs to you, but other people use it much more than you do?
Everyone else says your name far more often than you do! 📛
Which gas makes up most of the air we breathe?
Air is about 78% nitrogen and only about 21% oxygen! 🌬️
Which is more: 30% of 50, or 50% of 30?
Both come to exactly 15, so neither one wins! 🔄
In a three-legged race, 2 kids tie one leg each together. How many legs do the 2 kids have?
Tying legs together doesn't make any of them disappear! 🏃
Which is longer: 3 days or 70 hours?
3 days are 72 hours, just a bit more than 70! ⏳
How many holes does a T-shirt have?
One for your head, one at the bottom, and two for your arms! 👕
How many edges does a cube have?
4 on top, 4 on the bottom and 4 going up the sides: 12! 🧊
The water in each kernel turns to steam and bursts it open! 🍿
If yesterday was the 31st of the month, what is the date today?
No month has a 32nd day, so a new month starts on the 1st! 📅
Which is bigger: Greenland or Africa?
Flat maps stretch places near the poles, so Greenland looks huge! 🗺️
At about what temperature does water boil on top of Mount Everest?
With less air pushing down up high, water boils at only about 70 °C! 🏔️
What is ordinary window glass mostly made from?
Sand is melted at very high heat and cooled into glass! 🪟
A truck gets stuck under a low bridge, just a few cm too tall. What is the easiest way to free it?
Softer tires make the truck a little lower, so it can roll out! 🚚
A clock with hands shows 6:00. What time does it seem to show in a mirror?
One hand points straight up and one straight down, so the mirror shows the same! 🪞
Which color of star is the hottest?
Red stars are the coolest, and blue stars are the hottest! ⭐
Which is correct: 7 plus 8 is 13, or 7 plus 8 is 14?
Don't let the choices fool you: 7 + 8 = 15! ✅
You carry a closed bag of chips up a very high mountain. What happens to the bag?
Less air pushes on the bag up high, so the air inside swells it! ⛰️
A baby is born in Paris to Chinese parents. What language does the baby speak on its first day?
Newborn babies can only cry; talking comes much later! 👶
A painting shows a clock at 3:00. What time will the painted clock show 1 hour later?
A painted clock never moves, so it always says 3:00! 🖼️
A clock with hands has stopped. How many times a day does it still show the right time?
Its hands point to the right time once in the morning and once at night! 🕰️
What can you put into a bucket of water to make it lighter?
Make a hole and the water runs out, so the bucket gets lighter! 🪣
Lina's mother has 4 daughters: Spring, Summer and Autumn. What is the 4th daughter's name?
You stand exactly on the South Pole. Which direction is every way you can walk?
At the very bottom of the Earth, every step takes you north! 🧭
A 3 by 3 by 3 cube is painted red outside, then cut into 27 small cubes. How many small cubes have no paint at all?
Only the one small cube hidden in the very middle never saw the paint! 🎨
One ice cube is wrapped in a warm wool sweater and another is left out in the same room. Which melts first?
A sweater makes no heat; it keeps the room's heat away from the ice! 🧶
A rope has 2 ends. If you cut it once in the middle, how many ends are there?
Now there are 2 ropes, and each one has 2 ends! 🪢
Snow looks white, but what color is each tiny ice crystal of a snowflake?
Clear crystals bounce light in every direction, which makes snow look white! ❄️
What happens when you drop a whole apple into a big bowl of water?
Apples are about a quarter air, so they float! 🍏
Walking from floor 1 to floor 3 takes 2 minutes. At the same speed, how long from floor 1 to floor 6?
1 to 3 is 2 flights of stairs, so 1 to 6 is 5 flights: 5 minutes! 🪜
On your way to the park, you meet 3 kids leaving the park, each with 2 parents. How many people are going to the park?
Everyone you met was leaving the park, so only you are going! 🌳
A fair coin lands on heads 5 times in a row. What is the chance it lands on heads the next time?
A coin has no memory: every flip is a fresh 50-50! 🪙
Two sisters were born to the same mother on the same day of the same year, but they are not twins. How?
There's a third sister, so they are 2 of triplets! 👭
Where does bread go stale the fastest?
Fridge cold makes bread go stale faster, but freezing stops it! 🍞
Mushrooms aren't plants at all; they belong to the fungus family! 🍄
Ben has 3 sisters. How many sisters does each of Ben's sisters have?
A girl can't be her own sister, so each one has the other 2! 👧
Each pineapple grows from the middle of a short, spiky plant! 🍍
Which of these is a berry, according to plant scientists?
Bananas are true berries, but strawberries and raspberries are not! 🍌
A metal spoon and a wooden spoon lie in the same room all night. Which one is colder in the morning?
Metal only feels colder because it pulls heat from your hand faster! 🥄
Three years ago Ali was 10. How old will he be in 3 years?
Ali is 13 now, so in 3 years he will be 16! 🧒
You are driving a bus: 6 kids get on, 2 get off, then 4 more get on. How old is the bus driver?
You are the driver, so the driver is exactly as old as you! 🚌
On which continent is the North Pole?
The North Pole sits on frozen ocean, not on land! 🧊
What always goes up but never comes down?
Every birthday adds a year, and you never get one back! 🎂
Sam was born on 29 February 2000. By the end of 2012, how many real birthdays has he had?
February 29 only comes in leap years: 2004, 2008 and 2012! 📆
What is black when it's clean and white when it's dirty?
White chalk is what makes a black board dirty! 🏫
When you write all the numbers from 1 to 100, how many times do you write the digit 9?
Don't forget 90 to 99, which all start with a 9: 10 + 10 = 20! ✏️
What shape is a falling raindrop?
Real raindrops are round, never pointy like in drawings! 🌧️
You drive 60 km at 60 km/h, then drive back the same 60 km at 30 km/h. What was your average speed?
120 km took 1 hour + 2 hours = 3 hours, and 120 ÷ 3 = 40! 🚗
What color is a giraffe's tongue?
A giraffe's long tongue is dark purple, not pink like ours! 🦒
What can you put between 2 and 3 to get a number bigger than 2 but smaller than 3?
Put a point between them and you get 2.3! 🔢
Standing on the Moon during the day, what color is the sky?
The Moon has no air to scatter sunlight, so its sky stays black! 🌑
When is the Eiffel Tower a little taller?
Heat makes its iron expand, so it grows up to about 15 cm in summer! 🗼
Where is most of Earth's fresh water?
About two thirds of all fresh water is locked up in ice! 🥶
How do most fish close their eyes to sleep?
Most fish have no eyelids, so they rest with their eyes open! 🐟
What goes all the way around the world but never moves?
The equator circles the whole Earth without ever going anywhere! 🌐
Which gives more in 30 days: 1,000 coins every day, or 1 coin on day 1 that doubles every day?
Doubling grows so fast that day 30 alone brings over 500 million coins! 💰
Where does sound travel faster: through air or through water?
Sound moves about 4 times faster in water than in air! 🐋
A clock is 10 minutes slow and shows 9:50. What is the real time?
A slow clock is behind, so the real time is 10 minutes later! ⏰
A coin is in a bottle closed with a cork. How can you get it out without pulling the cork or breaking the bottle?
Push the cork down into the bottle, then tip the coin out! 🪙
If the 1st of the month is a Monday, what date is the next Monday?
One week after the 1st is 1 + 7, the 8th! 🗓️
What is the opposite of the opposite of hot?
The opposite of hot is cold, and the opposite of cold is hot again! 🔥
How many 1 cm cubes does it take to build one 2 cm cube?
At exactly 3:15, what is the angle between a clock's hour hand and minute hand?
By 3:15 the hour hand has moved a quarter of the way from 3 to 4! 🕒
What slowly happens to ice cubes left in the freezer for a few months?
Bits of ice slowly turn straight into vapor, even in the freezer! 🧊
If you could drive a car to the Moon at 100 km/h without stopping, about how long would it take?
The Moon is about 384,000 km away, which is about 160 days of driving! 🌕
A 1 km train goes into a 1 km tunnel at 1 km per minute. How long until the whole train is out?
The front goes 1 km through, then the tail needs 1 km more: 2 minutes! 🚇
What happens to a banana's skin if you keep it in the fridge?
Bananas hate the cold: the skin goes dark, though the inside stays fine! 🍌
Four kids stood under one small umbrella, but none of them got wet. How?
No rain, no wet kids, no matter how small the umbrella! ☂️
How many corners does one of Egypt's Great Pyramids have?
4 corners at the bottom, plus 1 at the very top! 🔺
What can fill a whole room but takes up no space at all?
Air takes up space, but light fills a room without needing any! 💡
How many legs do 2 spiders and 2 ants have in total?
Spiders have 8 legs each and ants only 6: 16 + 12 = 28! 🐜
Who is your mother's only brother's only sister?
If your uncle has only one sister, she must be your mom! 👩
Which is bigger: our Moon or Pluto?
Pluto is only about two thirds as wide as our Moon! 🌕
A man shaves many times every day, but he still has a long beard. How?
He shaves other people's faces all day, not his own! 💈
In a row of kids, Mia is 5th from the left and 5th from the right. How many kids are in the row?
4 kids on each side of Mia, plus Mia herself: 4 + 4 + 1 = 9! 🧍
Which is longest: 1 meter, 100 centimeters or 1,000 millimeters?
They are just 3 ways of saying the same length! 📏
How tall must a wall mirror be for you to see your whole body in it?
Light bounces at an angle, so half your height is always enough! 🪞
What color are sunsets on Mars?
Martian dust lets blue light through near the Sun, so sunsets glow blue! 🔴
How many planets in our solar system have rings?
Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune all have rings; Saturn's are the brightest! 🪐
In a seahorse family, who carries the eggs until the babies hatch?
Seahorse dads keep the eggs in a pouch until the babies pop out! 🌊
What is the largest number of Sundays one year can have?
A year is 52 weeks plus 1 or 2 days, so one weekday can come 53 times! ☀️
Who is your parents' child, but not your brother or your sister?
You are your parents' child too! 😄
Each box holds 10 eggs. How many boxes do you need to pack 25 eggs?
2 boxes hold only 20, so the last 5 eggs need a 3rd box! 📦
About how big is a kangaroo when it is born?
A newborn kangaroo is about 2 cm long and grows up in its mom's pouch! 🦘
Does adding salt make water boil faster?
Salt is for taste; it actually makes water boil a tiny bit later! 🧂
Which part of the plant is a potato?
A potato is a swollen underground stem, and its eyes can grow new shoots! 🥔
If 2 hours ago it was 1 hour after 3 o'clock, what time is it now?
1 hour after 3 is 4, and 2 hours after that is 6! 🕕
Kids sit evenly, in order, around a round table, and kid 3 is right across from kid 8. How many kids are there?
Across the table is halfway around: 8 - 3 = 5, and 5 × 2 = 10! 🍽️
What happens when you put a fresh raw egg into a bowl of water?
Fresh eggs sink; only old eggs with a big air pocket float! 🍳
Does a pot of water come to a boil faster with the lid on or off?
The lid keeps the heat in, so the water boils sooner! 🍲
You take 5 steps forward, then 5 steps back. How many steps did you walk?
You ended where you started, but you still walked 10 steps! 👣
What is always coming, but never actually arrives?
When tomorrow finally comes, it's called today! 🌅
Diamonds are made of the same stuff as which of these?
Both are pure carbon; only the way the atoms are packed is different! 💎
At what time of day are you a tiny bit taller?
Your back stretches out while you sleep and squishes a little by evening! 🛏️
100 kg of watermelons are 99% water, and after drying in the sun they are 98% water. What do they weigh now?
The 1 kg of dry part is now 2% of the total, so it all weighs 50 kg! 🍉
What is the one thing you no longer have once you share it?
Once you tell a secret, it's not a secret anymore! 🤫
Can astronauts on the Moon see the Great Wall of China with just their eyes?
The wall is long but narrow, and the Moon is about 384,000 km away! 🔭
